
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/19968140" title="发布于 2026-05-03 09:41">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">8.【保姆级】从零学会LangChain调用大模型！统一接口+代码实战</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>模型调用场景中，用户常会根据个人使用习惯指定偏好的AI大模型厂商及名称。比如阿里巴巴的 qwen3.6-plus、qwen3.5-max，字节跳动的 doubao-pro等国产主流旗舰型号，以及OpenAI的gpt-4o、Anthropic 的claude-3.5-sonnet等海外型号，都是用户会结合任务复杂度、成本预算、合规要求等因素，在不同使用场景中高频指定的调用对象。</p>
<p>如果喜欢看视频学习的，可以看这个<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1FJokBfEXw/" rel="noopener nofollow">《8.【保姆级】从零学会LangChain调用大模型！统一接口+代码实战》</a>，喜欢看文章的接着往下看。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260503093730011-497157501.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>为提升开发效率，新版 LangChain1.2.x+将不同厂商 AI 大模型的调用逻辑做了统一封装，整合到init_chat_model中完成统一调用，大幅简化多模型适配开发。核心参数仅需关注两个：</p>
<p>model：指定具体的模型名称，如 gpt-5.5、deepseek-v3；</p>
<p>model_provider：指定模型提供商标识，如 openai、deepseek。若未指定，系统将根据 model 参数的前缀推断模型提供商，如model=“openai:gpt-5.5”，会推断为openai。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">init_chat_model(
  model: str </span>| None =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None,
  </span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  model_provider: str </span>| None =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None,
  configurable_fields: Literal[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">any</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] | list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None,
  config_prefix: str </span>| None =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None,
  </span>**kwargs: Any =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}
) </span>-&gt; BaseChatModel | _ConfigurableModel</pre>
</div>
<p>统确定大模型提供商后，便会自动实例化对应厂商的原生实现类 —— 比如 OpenAI 对应 ChatOpenAI、Anthropic 对应 ChatAnthropic、DeepSeek 对应 ChatDeepSeek 等，开发者无需手动引入，只需通过init_chat_model统一入口即可完成底层适配。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260503093831361-1972730197.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;在实现类对象上，常用invoke和stream两种调用方法。invoke 会让大模型一次性返回完整响应对象，<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="stream" data-pretit="stream">stream则逐Token输出内容片段。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260503093847034-1269364019.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;下面通过代码实战，带你彻底搞懂。首先打开命令行窗口，使用 pip 命令安装&nbsp;<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="LangChain" data-pretit="langchain">LangChain和langchain-openai开发库。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip install langchain langchain-openai</pre>
</div>
<p>通过dotenv库的load_dotenv()方法，自动读取项目里的.env配置文件，把文件中所有键值对自动载入系统环境变量os.environ，后续可直接读取模型地址、密钥等配置，避免硬编码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
 
load_dotenv()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>使用 LangChain 内置的init_chat_model初始化大模型，通过两个核心参数配置：model指定模型名称，model_provider指定模型对接厂商。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
 
load_dotenv()
llm </span>= init_chat_model(model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">qwen3.6-plus</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, model_provider=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(type(llm))</pre>
</div>
<p>当厂商参数设为openai时，底层会自动调用ChatOpenAI实现类，并从环境变量自动读取API密钥和接口地址。这里打印模型实例类型和请求基准地址，方便查看底层配置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.chat_models <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model
 
load_dotenv()
llm </span>= init_chat_model(model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">qwen3.6-plus</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, model_provider=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(type(llm))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">base_url:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, llm.root_client.base_url)</pre>
</div>
<p>可以省略model_provider参数，直接在模型名称前加上厂商前缀，格式为厂商:模型名，一行代码即可完成大模型初始化，写法更简洁。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.chat_models <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model
 
load_dotenv()
llm </span>= init_chat_model(model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai:qwen3.6-plus</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(type(llm))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">base_url:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, llm.root_client.base_url)</pre>
</div>
<p>大模型初始化完成后，使用invoke()方法发起对话请求。该方式会等待模型生成完整内容后，一次性返回全部结果。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.chat_models <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model
 
load_dotenv()
llm </span>= init_chat_model(model=os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MODEL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
result </span>= llm.invoke(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是谁呀？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result)</pre>
</div>
<p>想要实现打字机实时输出效果，改用stream()方法循环遍历模型返回内容。end=""保证文字连续不换行，flush=True强制即时打印，实现流畅的流式对话效果。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.chat_models <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> init_chat_model
 
load_dotenv()
llm </span>= init_chat_model(model=os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MODEL</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> chunk <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> llm.stream(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">详细介绍AI大模型的应用</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chunk.content:       
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(chunk.content, end=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>, flush=True)</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
